sources.locator: Highway glossary: Velocitation; Exiting the Freeway, steps 5–6
sources.excerpt: Make sure you do frequent speedometer checks to help adjust your speed.
sources.supports: Prolonged steady-speed driving can alter perceived speed; speedometer checks help adjustment after leaving fast traffic.
sources.fallback_reason: Targeted TS/TRV searches did not locate exact speed-adaptation and instrument-check guidance. VTI results inspected did not establish this complete transition advice. ODOT provides direct official driver education.
sources.scope_limits: Perceptual/safety advice only. No foreign traffic laws, speed limits or stopping distances imported; feeling slow does not prove instrument failure, nor establish an instrument can never fail.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct official primary page/PDF retrieved; exact passage inspected

sources.excerpt: där det finns möjlighet att vända
sources.supports: Agency example replaces an unavailable left turn with routing to an identified turning location.
sources.scope_limits: Historical local closure example, not current route advice or a verbatim general recommendation about heavy rural traffic. sources.publisher: Swedish Government; published by Sveriges riksdag
sources.title: Traffic Regulation (1998:1276)
sources.version: Consolidated live text; relevant current provisions checked 13 October 2026
sources.excerpt: En förare får vända eller backa endast om det kan ske utan fara eller hinder för andra vägtrafikanter.
sources.supports: Turning/leaving road must protect oncoming and same-direction/rear traffic; turning around must avoid danger/obstruction; motorway/expressway turnaround and reversing prohibited.
sources.fallback_reason: Trafikverket example does not specify the complete general legal boundary. Current Swedish statute supplies precise constraints rather than inventing an unconditional route recommendation.
sources.scope_limits: These provisions constrain the conditional editorial example; they do not explicitly recommend return-right routing. Other signs, access restrictions, controls and local rules remain applicable.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct official primary page/PDF retrieved; exact passage inspected

sources.title: Se upp för vilt på vägarna
sources.locator: När är det störst risk för vilt- och renolyckor?; Passager för vilt under eller över vägen; Faunapassager med viltvarningssystem
sources.excerpt: Var särskilt uppmärksam i gryning och skymning.
sources.supports: Year-round animal risk, increased attention at dawn/dusk, natural animal routes and intentional fence openings for crossings.
sources.scope_limits: Prevention and observation only; not reproducing collision reporting from this page. No guarantee that fencing or absence of a warning proves an animal-free road.
